pick_implementation.title: Pick a sign-in method
pick_implementation.description: Choose "Doorcy account" unless you made your own Doorcy OAuth application.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Doorcy again
reauth_confirm.description: The Doorcy integration now signs in with your Doorcy account instead of a stored password. Sign in once more to continue.

abort.already_configured: This Doorcy account is already set up.
abort.oauth2_missing_configuration: Signing in is not set up. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
abort.oauth2_missing_credentials: Signing in is not set up. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
abort.oauth2_no_url_available: No URL available to sign in. Check that Home Assistant has an external URL or use My Home Assistant.
abort.oauth2_implementation_unavailable: The sign-in method is not available yet. Try again later.

application_credentials.description: Optional. Adding the integration needs no credentials; only enter your own Doorcy OAuth application (authorization code, redirect URI {redirect_uri}) if you want to sign in with it. Its client ID and client secret are asked below.
